name: infantry-scout
_doc: Korean Empire (대한제국군) scout (정찰병): infantry-default body/uniform (dark field grey, kepi with team band, no placket), short cavalry-type carbine, field binoculars on a neck strap at the chest, light kit (bread bag + canteen + small map case, no pack). Anims = infantry-motions + binoculars poses (bases/infantry_scout.py).
